newsitem.title: USA: CME hog calls mixed, pork bellies steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: CME hog calls mixed, pork bellies steady to lower.

text.p: Early calls on CME hog futures ranged from 0.100 cent higher to 0.100 lower, with pork belly futures steady to 0.250 cent lower, analysts said.

Expectations that cash hog supplies will remain tight encouraged steady to higher indications on hog futures, especially after the late rally in futures Thursday and posting of new contract highs in October through February during the day.
Cash hog prices have risen to the highest level since mid August hog numbers will remain tight into next year, they said.

However, packers are seen cutting back on the pace of slaughter next week citing high hog prices and reduced product movement. This could make for uneven cash hog markets and encourage profit taking in futures. Expectations of weakness in other meat pits will also weigh on sentiment, they said.

Pork bellies are seen show further weakness following losses in the cash market. Although talk of packers reducing hog kills would be supportive to futures, cash market values are seen declining the next few weeks on a seasonal basis, they added.
